records.description:
183 Solar combines residential and commercial solar projects with equipment procurement for installers and EPCs. Its turnkey work covers planning, engineering, installation and commissioning. The company also helps manufacturers and suppliers reach installation businesses.

Its service work includes grid-connected PV systems, panel removal and replacement, inverter servicing, EV charging and residential roofing. Equipment supply covers modules, PV wire, inverters and mounting components.
records.tagline: Solar EPC, equipment procurement and system services

CMCO Electric & Solar is an electrical and solar contractor based in Loomis, California. Its team works on homes, businesses, agricultural properties and multi-tenant buildings in Northern California.

The company designs and installs solar, integrates battery backup and installs EV chargers and standby generators. It also diagnoses existing solar systems, including installations completed by other companies, and produces electrical and solar plans for new construction and renovations.
records.tagline: Solar, electrical work, battery backup and system repairs

Iddings Electric provides residential and commercial electrical work in Central Pennsylvania. Its home services include rewiring, panel upgrades, lighting, generators and surge protection.

For commercial properties, the company handles electrical work for new construction, elevated repairs using bucket trucks, and parking-lot and warehouse lighting. Its published service area includes Lancaster, Berks, Chester and York counties.

Steiner Electric is a full-service electrical contractor in West Bend, serving Southeastern Wisconsin. Its work spans electrical construction, design, service and maintenance for commercial and industrial facilities.

The company offers power-distribution upgrades, machinery-power relocations, emergency power, medium-voltage work and LED lighting upgrades. Design-build and plan/spec delivery sit alongside its renewable-energy and preventive-maintenance services.

Sun Directed designs and installs solar, battery backup, heat pumps and EV charging for homes, businesses and farms around State College and Bellefonte, Pennsylvania. The company plans these systems together for properties undertaking broader electrification work.

Its solar work includes residential, commercial and agricultural systems. Battery options include Tesla Powerwall 3 and FranklinWH, while heating and cooling services include Daikin inverter heat pumps.

Risa Solar is a solar-equipment distributor serving installers, EPCs, developers and utilities. Its product catalogue includes PV modules, batteries, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, EV chargers and electrical components.

The company offers equipment procurement and delivery support, including bulk orders. Its product catalogue distinguishes equipment supply from installation work.

records.description:
Amicus O&M Cooperative supports independently owned solar operations and maintenance businesses. It provides technical training, shared tools, work templates and a forum for members to exchange expertise.

When a customer needs service, the cooperative introduces them to member companies serving the relevant area. Those companies contract with customers and perform the field work; the cooperative supports the network.
records.tagline: Training, shared resources and referrals for solar O&M companies

services.detail: Connects customers with independent member companies serving the region where a solar site is located.
